title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1548: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (2)

title.p: Chapter 1548: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (2)

section.p: A five elemental Invincible asked, “Auspicious Golden, how did Su Yu get the nine-leaf skylotus?”

Auspicious Golden was the metal elemental who had helped humanity in the mansion. Hearing the question, he rolled his eyes. What a stupid question. This guy should have entered the mansion himself if he wanted to know.
Auspicious Golden considered merely surviving the mansion a massive accomplishment. Why bother asking about the skylotus? Did this dumbass think that he was stronger than Blood Fire?

Despite his thoughts, he answered differently, “I am not clear. Su Yu seemed to have gained control over a terrifying existence in the mansion. He was able to summon that existence to instantly kill everyone. Even Blood Fire was severely injured by that existence. We only got lucky and survived because we didn’t have the courage to fight over the skylotus in the first place.”

Terrifying existence? How strong could something that was terrifying even for Invincibles be? Some of the Invincibles linked that to the violent shaking of the mansion earlier. Understanding dawned on them.
No wonder.

No wonder Su Yu could kill so many people and win the ultimate treasure of the mansion. So he had gotten a backer in the mansion. That was why. The Invincibles started looking at the survivors with shining eyes.
Some even took out special eyes in their hands.
Daofuse eyes.

They were scanning the survivors. An eye paused slightly on Great Qin King, but it wasn’t able to see through anything. Someone noticed Zhan Wushuang and the others. All of them were unconscious and sealed. Noticing that, the divines looked at the humans with unsightly expressions.
Great Qin King remained silent. Zhu Tianfang smiled and said, “Don’t look at us. Su Yu sealed them. Divines, you better not get involved in this or these people might die accidentally in the chaos.”
Some of the divines started hesitating.
Some wanted to snatch the sealed divine survivors back, but a different Invincible said, “Wait until we’re done with the inspection.”

How could they be sure that Su Yu wasn’t hidden among the sealed divines? Multiple Daofuse eyes were active, making it clear that multiple Daofuses were performing the inspection, checking the past, present, and future of the survivors.
They did not check the seas of willpower of the survivors. That was too big of a taboo. After all, many of the survivors were the descendants of the various Invincibles.
After some time, someone looked at the humans and coldly ordered, “All humans, open your seas of willpower for inspection.”
Great Qin King’s gaze turned cold as he asked, “What is that again?”
“Great Ming King, don’t think that we have no idea what you’re thinking. Are you trying to protect Su Yu?”
A different Invincible said, “Su Yu must be hiding among the humans.”
Xia Longwu said, “He still cares about the human race or there won’t be so many survivors among the humans. Why would he hide among the human survivors, knowing the risk it posed? Use your brain.”
“Hmph!”

Xia Longwu’s argument made sense, but the myriad races were finding this unacceptable. Not only had so many of them survived, but they had even gained a new Invincible as Yun Chen had affirmed his dao in the mansion. Thus, they had to take this chance to make things difficult for the humans.

Great Ming King, who was disguised as Great Zhou King, said, “You are only looking for Su Yu. Are you really doing that, or are you trying to start a war with the human race? Don’t forget that you won’t benefit much from a war either.”

He had noticed that Great Qin King’s aura wasn’t too weak. Thus, he was quite surprised. Had Great Qin King recovered? Was that it? In any case, the human Invincibles couldn’t see anything wrong with Great Qin King.
Nobody cared about what Su Yu was doing. Everyone was focused on the survivors.

Even the four Invincibles around him were rather relaxed. They wouldn’t do anything as long as Grandstar did nothing. Grandstar might be strong, but not strong enough to handle all four of them easily. After all, there was a seventh-degree Eternal among them.

Grandstar was most likely an eighth-degree Eternal, but due to his age, he might be stronger than younger Eternals of the same level. Nevertheless, the gap shouldn’t be high enough that he could deal with all four of them without much trouble.
Furthermore, Grandstar was restricted by his duty. He would be helpless as long as they left the ancient city alone.
As for Su Yu, he was looking more and more helpless. What should he do now?

He gnashed his teeth and shouted, “I’m Su Yu! I’m the real Su Yu! If you hit me, you will provoke the holy cities! This is my final warning! Don’t push it! Tian Yu, I’m warning you! Hitting me is the same as declaring war against the holy cities! I will have all the guardians act and kill you all!”
“Hahaha!”
Immortal King Tian Yu laughed. This clown was too amusing.

He looked at Grandstar and said, “Guardian Grandstar, is it fine for me to kill him? He’s just a regular resident. I understand if you wish to fight for your mayor, but I doubt a regular resident is worth the trouble, right?”
Grandstar said coldly, “Not even a regular resident can be killed inside the city, but it’s fine outside the city. But Su Yu is my mayor. Killing him is an act of war.”

“Hahaha! But he’s not Su Yu!” Tian Yu roared with laughter and said, “Boy, stop running your mouth. It’s time for you to rest. If you keep running your mouth, I’ll show you what it means to be an Eternal. Do you understand me?”

Toward the end, his words started carrying some killing intent and rage. It was time for the fake Su Yu to shut up. Why was a nobody like this being so noisy here? Was he done? Su Yu was qualified to provoke Invincibles, but not this nobody.

Su Yu nodded inwardly. Everything was progressing well. He was done with the first part of the act. These people would most certainly attack after this. He started looking around to pick his targets in advance. Who should he spare? Who should he kill?
Not one of the people surrounding the human race would be spared. As for those remaining spectators, he could spare them temporarily. After all, there were too many of them to kill.
When one was killing the chicken to warn the monkey, the monkey should not be killed, especially when the monkey wasn’t too easy to kill.
At that, Su Yu roared furiously, “Impudent! You are challenging the holy cities! All guardians, heed my command. If any of them dare to touch me, kill them all!”
No reply came.
After a short while, Heavendoom’s lazy voice rang out, “Yeah, yeah, got it. If they attack, we’ll kill them all. Attacking Su Yu is an act of war. We understand.”
A bunch of people roared with laughter.
Why were the guardians playing along?
Could they even leave their cities?
Most Invincibles weren’t taking that seriously.
But the expression of a certain someone changed dramatically.
Topsoil Spirit looked at Auspicious Golden and sent a voice transmission, “Elder, quick! Tell the old fogeys from our race to move away! Now!”
Auspicious Golden blanked out. What was it now?
“Can’t you see it, Elder? That’s Su Yu!”

Topsoil Spirit didn’t know what to say anymore. Wasn’t this obvious? That was the real Su Yu! The prelude was done. The moment those Invincibles attacked, a war would erupt. Chaos would descend. The guardians would act. Su Yu had promised that repeatedly.
Attacking Su Yu was an act of war. Was that not clear enough? Was that not obvious enough?
Auspicious Golden blanked out again. No way, right? Was that the real Su Yu?
Was Su Yu not…hiding among the survivors?
Was this a joke?
He had thought that Su Yu was among the survivors. Was that not the case?
Holy shit!
So he was out here preparing all along?
At the same time, Mo Duona frowned as he stared at the distant Su Yu. If this was really a fake Su Yu, he must be a fool. Who would take these threats seriously?
But what if he was real? Had Su Yu left the mansion earlier?
How?
Death tunnel?

Mo Duona was feeling suspicious, but he said nothing. Instead, he looked at the distant Devil King Moge. After a slight hesitation, he said, “Ancestor, inspect me first. I wish to leave first. I’m injured.”

Moge looked at Mo Duona. There were very few devil survivors this time. Apart from Mo Duona, a few other devils had also survived through sheer luck. However, Mo Duona was the most important person among them.

Moge inspected Mo Duona with the Daofuse eye before saying, “Everyone, Mo Duona has the aura of the Devil Emperor’s blood essence on him. There is no way he’s Su Yu. I’ll take charge of him personally. Is this acceptable?”

The other Invincibles gave it some thought and said nothing. Since this was someone with the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s blood essence on him, it should be fine. No matter how brazen Su Yu was, he wouldn’t dare to keep the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s blood essence on him as that might make him vulnerable to the Devil Pseudo Emperor.
